event_name: Time 16:39 2018 ABU DHABI GRAND PRIX 22 - 25 November The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 21) and heard from the driver and team representative, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 7 did not stay to the right of the white line leading to the safety car line and also crossed the white line separating the pit entry and the track.
offence: Breach of Appendix L Chapter IV Article 4 (d) of the FIA International Sporting Code and Race Directors Instruction.
penalty: A penalty of a Reprimand is imposed. This is the driver's first Reprimand of the Season (Driving).
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of car 7 (Kimi Raikkonen) and the team representative. The Stewards reviewed video evidence. The Race Director's instruction in Event Notes 8.2 states "when entering the pits drivers must stay to the right of the solid white line". In Appendix L Chapter IV Article 4 (d) states "..the crossing….of the line…by a car entering the pit lane…" In this case, whilst car 7 did not enter the pits, it was in the process of entering the pit lane and the pits. Therefore, a breach is considered to have occurred. Both offences were considered to be part of one incident so a single Reprimand is imposed.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
